$comment: Open-data event datasets (docs/design/collector/COLLECTOR_COMPLETION.md 2.7). Each dataset joins, as a lane 1 seed, every run region whose circle overlaps its bbox ([minLng, minLat, maxLng, maxLat]). Add one only after reading its licence: it must list scheduled public events with a start date and permit reuse with attribution. The open-data scout (opendata-scout.yml) finds candidates. Scout of 2026-11-05 (Atlanta metro, London, Leipzig, Freiburg, Calgary): no Socrata event dataset had 3 or more rows inside the Atlanta, London, Leipzig or Freiburg boxes, and the ArcGIS Hub search ignored the box and returned survey, permit-form and planning layers from everywhere, none a public events calendar for those regions; the two Atlanta placeholders were removed from data/cities/atl.json. Calgary's portal lists the City's public events calendar.

datasets.name: City of Calgary Events
datasets.attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – City of Calgary.

licence.name: Open Government Licence – City of Calgary

datasets.note: The City's public events calendar (dataset n625-9k5x; columns read with the scout's inspect on 2026-11-05: title, event_type, event_group, notes, more_info_url, host_organization, all_dates, next_date_times as text such as "November 7 2026 9 - 10 a.m.", address, latitude, longitude, point). The portal labels its licence "See Terms of Use", which is the Open Government Licence – City of Calgary (reuse for any purpose with attribution). Switched on 2026-11-08 at Sai's direction, with the attribution he gave ("Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – City of Calgary."), shown on the event page, the share page and the /bot open-data list.
